The hormone Melatonin regulates the day-night cycle of the human body and controls the recovery phases during the sleep. For the production of this hormone, the human body requires sufficient darkness. Lightness prevents the production of Melatonin. Even a little light caused, for example, by a digital clock can be a disturbance. Sleeping masks however provide complete darkness for your sleep.

- if you want to sleep while travelling, e.g. on airplanes or in trains.

The hormone Melatonin regulates the day-night cycle of the human body and controls the recovery phases during the sleep. Lancet Extractors usage instructions:

Use a lancet needle to poke a tiny hole into one area at a time. The lancet should slide easily into the top. description: Redmond Clay is an old Home Remedy used for generations. Redmond Clay’s origins are as old as the practice of putting a mud poultice on a bee sting. description: Benefits: PASSION FRUIT: The passion fruit (Passiflora edulis) is a climbing plant belonging to the Passifloraceae family, native to Paraguay, Brazil and north-east Argentina. Its name makes reference to the passion of Christ. The religious people who first discovered the plant in South America are believed to have seen the crown of thorns in the spiky tips of the flower. The passion flower is cultivated for its fruit, and is grown like a vine on a frame in hot regions of the world. The passion fruit itself is known in Creole as maracudja, and maracujá in Brazil. It is also called pomme-liane (literally climbing apples) in New Caledonia, grenadia (due to its resemblance to the pomegranate) in Haiti and grenadine on the island of Réunion. In cosmetics, the flesh of the passion fruit is used for its vitamin C content, which is reputed to protect cells against free radicals resulting from pollution and UV rays. It also stimulates the synthesis of collagen (connecting tissue in the skin) and diminishes and prevents skin pigmentation due to the sun or old age. PINK CLAY: Used for thousands of years, clay is a mild, naturally occurring mineral product. It is the result of a long process of erosion taking place within the natural environment. Produced from the combined action of wind and water, it is extracted from the ground, dried in the sun and ground to a very fine powder. Rich in trace elements, pink clay possesses purifying, clarifying, re-mineralising and toning virtues. Due to its soothing and softening qualities, it is also recommended for delicate, sensitive and reactive skin types.

The eyelid has glands that produce an oil that is the consistency of olive oil, and that oil helps coat your tear layer to prevent evaporation. For many with irritated eyes the glands can produce secretions that are thick, like butter, and clog the glands. To keep the glands secreting properly, heating the glands with the Eye Compress can unclog the glands, providing a stable tear layer. Also known as Ghassoul, Oxide Clay or Moroccan Lava Clay, Rhassoul Clay is an ancient clay mined in the fertile depths of the Atlas Mountains in Eastern Morocco. The clay formed in the Altas Mountains over centuries of natural geothermal processes and volcanic activities. This clay is as natural as it gets, flowing with the river and drying in the desert to obtain this miraculous product.

Moroccan Rhassoul Clay has been used by many ancient civilizations as a soap, shampoo and skin conditioner, today, the finest spas across the world use the clay in body masks to aid in rejuvenating, detoxifying and toning the skin

Why using a sleep mask?
The hormone Melatonin regulates the day-night cycle of the human body and controls the recovery phases during the sleep. For the production of this hormone, the human body requires sufficient darkness. Lightness prevents the production of Melatonin. Even a little light caused, for example, by a digital clock can be a disturbance. Sleeping masks however provide complete darkness for your sleep.

Sleep masks- what for?
- if you want to sleep while travelling, e.g. on airplanes or in trains.
- if your bedroom cannot completely be shaded by black-out curtains and you want to sleep in.
- if you cannot fall asleep because your partner wants to read or watch TV.
- if you are looking for perfect relaxation during yoga, wellness or meditation.

The hormone Melatonin regulates the day-night cycle of the human body and controls the recovery phases during the sleep. Powdered Activated Carbon (PAC) passes through 80-mesh sieve. This powder is 99% less than 325-mesh. PAC has a very large surface to volume ratio with small diffusion distance. One gram of PAC can have a surface area of ~1,000 square meters. Beauty: Teeth whitening, clarifying face masks, exfoliant. The hormone Melatonin regulates the day-night cycle of the human body and controls the recovery phases during the sleep. - if you want to sleep while travelling, e.g. on airplanes or in trains.

description:
Fountain of youth mask harnesses the power of Hungarian thermal water, botanicals and modern technologies. For years, people came from afar to soak in the mineral-rich, fountain of youth thermal waters of the Hungarian spas owned by Peter’s grandparents. Today, Peter uses one of the most mineral-rich thermal water sources on earth—a secret spring deep below Hungary’s Carpathian Valley where the earth’s crust is very thin, allowing water to absorb the most minerals as it bubbles to the surface. Rich and luxurious, this hydrating mask transforms with cool water into an invigorating flash of heat to open pores and optimize nutrient absorption. Infused with nine natural Hungarian botanicals and two bioengineered botanicals, Gatuline RC (from Beech Tree Buds) and Merospheres-V (from Rosemary). Helps reduce the look of fine lines, wrinkles, dullness, uneven skin tone and texture for smoother, younger, healthier-looking skin.

Fuente de máscara juvenil aprovecha el poder del agua termal húngara, los botánicos y las tecnologías modernas. Durante años, la gente llegó de lejos para sumergirse en la fuente rica en minerales de las aguas termales juveniles de los balnearios húngaros propiedad de los abuelos de Pedro. Hoy en día, Pedro utiliza una de las fuentes de agua termal más ricas en minerales de la tierra, un manantial secreto en lo profundo del valle de los Cárpatos de Hungría, donde la corteza terrestre es muy delgada, permitiendo que el agua absorba la mayor cantidad de minerales a medida que burbujea la superficie. Rica y lujosa, esta mascarilla hidratante se transforma con agua fría en un destello de calor estimulante para abrir los poros y optimizar la absorción de nutrientes. Infundido con nueve botánicos húngaros naturales y dos botánicos bioingenieros, Gatuline RC (de Beech Tree Buds) y Merospheres-V (de Romero). Ayuda a reducir el aspecto de líneas finas, arrugas, opacidad, tono de piel desigual y textura para una piel más suave, más joven y saludable.

Brunnen der Jugendmaske nutzt die Kraft von ungarischem Thermalwasser, botanischen Substanzen und modernen Technologien. Seit Jahren kamen die Menschen aus der Ferne in den mineralreichen Brunnen jugendlicher Thermalgewässer der ungarischen Spas, die von Peters Großeltern besessen wurden. Heute verwendet Peter eine der mineralreichsten thermischen Wasserquellen der Erde – eine geheime Quelle tief unter dem Karpatental, in der die Erdkruste sehr dünn ist, sodass Wasser die meisten Mineralien aufnehmen kann, da es an der Oberfläche Blasen Blasen hat. Reich und luxuriös, verwandelt sich diese feuchtigkeitsspendende Maske mit kaltem Wasser in einen belebenden Blitz, um die Poren zu öffnen und die Nährstoffaufnahme zu optimieren. Angereichert mit neun natürlichen ungarischen Pflanzenstoffen und zwei biotechnischen Pflanzenstoffen, Gatuline RC (aus Buchenbaumknospen) und Merospheres-V (aus Rosmarin) Reduziert das Aussehen von feinen Linien, Falten, Mattheit, unebenen Hautton und Textur für glattere, jüngere, gesünder aussehende Haut.

מסכת מזרקה לנוער רתמת את הכוח של מים תרמיים הונגריים, בוטניים וטכנולוגיות מודרניות. במשך שנים, אנשים באו מרחוק כדי להשרות את המים התרמיים העשירים במינרלים, מזרקה של מים תרמיים לנוער של הספא ההונגרי בבעלות הסבים והסבתות של פיטר. כיום, פיטר משתמש באחד ממקורות המים התרמיים העשירים במינרלים ביותר בעולם - קפיץ סודי עמוק מתחת לעמק הקרפטים של הונגריה, שם קרום כדור הארץ דק מאוד, ומאפשר למים לספוג את המינרלים ביותר כאשר הוא בועות אל פני השטח. עשירה ויוקרתית, מסכת לחות זו הופכת עם מים קרים לבזק ממריץ של חום כדי לפתוח נקבוביות ולמטב את ספיגת החומרים המזינים. חדור בתשעה בוטנים טבעיים הונגריים ושני בוטנים מהונדסים, גטולינה RC (מניצני עץ אשור) ומרוספרים-V (מרוזמרי). מסייע להפחית את המראה של קמטוטים, קמטים, קהות, גוון עור לא אחיד ומרקם לעור חלק יותר, צעיר יותר ובריא יותר.

A fonte de máscara jovem aproveita o poder da água termal húngara, produtos botânicos e tecnologias modernas. Durante anos, as pessoas vieram de longe para mergulhar na fonte rica em minerais, das águas termais juvenis dos spas húngaros de propriedade dos avós de Pedro. Hoje, Peter usa uma das fontes de água térmica mais ricas em minerais da Terra — uma fonte secreta no fundo do Vale dos Cárpatos da Hungria, onde a crosta da Terra é muito fina, permitindo que a água absorva mais minerais à medida que borra na superfície. Rica e luxuosa, esta máscara hidratante se transforma com água fria em um revigorante flash de calor para abrir os poros e otimizar a absorção de nutrientes. Infundido com nove produtos botânicos húngaros naturais e dois botânicos bioprojetados, Gatuline RC (de boca de árvore de faia) e Merospheres-V (de alecrim). Ajuda a reduzir a aparência das linhas finas, rugas, opacidade, tom de pele irregular e textura para uma pele mais suave, jovem e mais saudável.

Fountain of youth 面具利用匈牙利熱水、植物和現代技術的力量。 多年來,人們從遠方來到彼得祖父母所擁有的匈牙利水療中心富含礦物質的年輕溫泉中。 今天,Peter 使用地球上最富含礦物質的熱水源之一 - 這是匈牙利喀爾巴阡山谷深處的秘密泉源,那裡地殼非常薄,允許水吸收最多礦物質,因為它泡到表面。 這款保濕面膜豐富而奢華,可與冷水一起轉變為活力熱,打開毛孔並優化營養吸收。 加入九種天然匈牙利植物和兩種生物工程植物,Gatuline RC (來自山毛櫸樹叢)和 Merospheres-V(來自迷迭香)。 有助於減少細紋、皺紋、暗沉、膚色不均和紋理,讓肌膚更光滑、年輕、更健康。

青年面膜的喷泉利用匈牙利热水、植物和现代技术的力量。 多年来,人们从远处浸泡在彼得的祖父母拥有的匈牙利温泉水疗中心的富含矿物质的喷泉中。 今天,Peter 使用地球上富含矿物质的热水源之一 - 在匈牙利的卡尔巴蒂山谷下深处的秘密弹簧,地球的外壳非常薄,让水吸收大多数矿物质,产生气泡。 这款保湿面膜丰富而奢华,可用冷水转化为令人振奋的热量,打开毛孔,优化营养吸收。 含有九种匈牙利天然植物和两种生物工程植物,Gatuline RC (来自山毛榉树芽)和梅露珠-V(来自迷迭香)。 有助于减少细纹、皱纹、暗沉、不均匀肤色和质地,让肌肤更光滑、更年轻、更健康。

The hormone Melatonin regulates the day-night cycle of the human body and controls the recovery phases during the sleep. - if you want to sleep while travelling, e.g. on airplanes or in trains.

2.Use scissors to cut the seal on the foot masks.

description: Redmond Clay is an old Home Remedy used for generations. Redmond Clay’s origins are as old as the practice of putting a mud poultice on a bee sting. Geologically, Redmond Clay is volcanic ash that was deposited in sea water approximately 150 million years ago. Redmond Clay is a bentonite clay. Redmond brings this “clay of a thousand uses” to market in its natural state with no additives, chemicals or preservatives. The only processing it undergoes is crushing and screening. External Uses Mix the Redmond Clay with water to make a gel the consistency of mustard. Then apply the gel/paste directly on the skin for a drawing effect. If the clay is not covered it will dry out, and as it dries, you will feel it draw and pull. If you want a tightening effect, as in the case of a facial, leave it on until it is almost, but not totally dry, then remove. If you want a more cooling and soothing effect, cover the gel with a plastic covering or wet cloth so it won’t dry out. To remove the clay pack, simply wash it off with water and a gentle rubbing motion. Do not reuse the clay pack. Other external uses have been as a talcum powder or a diapering powder. Pre-mixed ready to use gel Mix two parts water with one part Redmond Clay to make a gel or mud. You can use a blender or mixer to speed up the process or you can just shake or stir by hand to create a smooth and creamy consistency. It should make a mud the consistency of mustard. If it seems too thin, add more clay. If it seems too thick add more water. Store the gel in a covered, non-metallic container and it will not dry out and will not separate. If it does dry out over prolonged storage, just add water and remix.

description: Redmond Clay is an old Home Remedy used for generations. Redmond Clay’s origins are as old as the practice of putting a mud poultice on a bee sting. Geologically, Redmond Clay is volcanic ash that was deposited in sea water approximately 150 million years ago. Redmond Clay is a bentonite clay. Redmond brings this “clay of a thousand uses” to market in its natural state with no additives, chemicals or preservatives. The only processing it undergoes is crushing and screening. External Uses Mix the Redmond Clay with water to make a gel the consistency of mustard. Then apply the gel/paste directly on the skin for a drawing effect. If the clay is not covered it will dry out, and as it dries, you will feel it draw and pull. If you want a tightening effect, as in the case of a facial, leave it on until it is almost, but not totally dry, then remove. If you want a more cooling and soothing effect, cover the gel with a plastic covering or wet cloth so it won’t dry out. To remove the clay pack, simply wash it off with water and a gentle rubbing motion. Do not reuse the clay pack. Other external uses have been as a talcum powder or a diapering powder. Pre-mixed ready to use gel Mix two parts water with one part Redmond Clay to make a gel or mud. You can use a blender or mixer to speed up the process or you can just shake or stir by hand to create a smooth and creamy consistency. It should make a mud the consistency of mustard. If it seems too thin, add more clay. If it seems too thick add more water. Store the gel in a covered, non-metallic container and it will not dry out and will not separate. If it does dry out over prolonged storage, just add water and remix.

Why using a sleep mask?
The hormone Melatonin regulates the day-night cycle of the human body and controls the recovery phases during the sleep. For the production of this hormone, the human body requires sufficient darkness. Lightness prevents the production of Melatonin. Even a little light caused, for example, by a digital clock can be a disturbance. Sleeping masks however provide complete darkness for your sleep.

Sleep masks- what for?
- if you want to sleep while travelling, e.g. on airplanes or in trains.

- if you cannot fall asleep because your partner wants to read or watch TV.

description: Bentonite Clay (cosmetic Grade) Bentonite clay [Sodium Bentonite] (a combination of montmorillonite and volcanic ash) is a highly absorbent clay best suited for oily skin. It is a fine powder, odorless and tasteless, insoluble in water, swelling to about eight times its weight when water is added. Uses: Suspending and colloidal agent in the manufacture of soap, also used in cosmetics and directly on the body as a treatment. Bentonite powder is added to soap at trace to help oily skin or as an additive in shaving soap (1T per #of soap). In face and body treatments it's not normally used as the predominant clay due to it's ability to absorb large quantities of water (thus making the treatment product take a very long time to dry). It is, however, used in smaller quantities to make treatment products more elastic. Also used to suspend pigments, thicken lotions and absorb oil.

Produced from the combined action of wind and water, it is extracted from the ground, dried in the sun and ground to a very fine powder. Green clay is rich in trace elements with purifying, mattifying, regenerative and remineralising qualities. description:
Description: French Green Clay comes from the sedimentation of Silico-aluminum, its coloring the result of the oxides contained in these rocks. French Green Clay is prepared for the commercial market by a process of sun-drying and crushing. After the clay has been mined, it is spread in the sun to remove excess water. It is then ground by large hydraulic crushers and micronized, or finely pulverized. The last stage in the process is a final period of sun-drying to remove the last traces of water.

Appearance: Light green colored powder.

Benefits: French Green Clay absorbs and removes impurities from the skin, stimulating blood flow to create healthy and glowing skin. When prepared as a mask, the clay dries on the skin causing pores to tighten and the skin to feel firm, toned and refreshed. French Green Clay can be used as a ready-to-use pastes to alleviate cuts, bruises, insect bites, stings, and minor burns; and mineral baths for stress relief. It is suitable for all skin types.

Application: French Green Clay can be used in detoxifying body wraps, soap making, face masks, mineral based or cream based cleansers, face or body scrubs, cosmetics and facial powders.

Caution: Caution should be exercised as clays may stain fabric.

Acne starts when a pore becomes plugged.

These plugs block sebum oil from reaching the skin surface causing inflammation and the development of acne bacteria.

What causes your pores to get plugged? Producing to much sebum oil.

The hormone Melatonin regulates the day-night cycle of the human body and controls the recovery phases during the sleep. For the production of this hormone, the human body requires sufficient darkness. Lightness prevents the production of Melatonin. Even a little light caused, for example, by a digital clock can be a disturbance. Sleeping masks however provide complete darkness for your sleep.

Sleep masks- what for?
- if you want to sleep while travelling, e.g. on airplanes or in trains.
- if your bedroom cannot completely be shaded by black-out curtains and you want to sleep in.
- if you cannot fall asleep because your partner wants to read or watch TV.
- if you are looking for perfect relaxation during yoga, wellness or meditation.

The hormone Melatonin regulates the day-night cycle of the human body and controls the recovery phases during the sleep. يعمل قناع الوجه الورقي فائق الترطيب على تنشيط البشرة. قناع الوجه المرطب المائي هذا بحمض الهيالورونيك، وهو مكون موجود بشكل طبيعي في البشرة، يغمر البشرة بترطيب مكثف خفيف الوزن. خالية من الزيوت المعدنية والبارابين، هذه التركيبة غير الدهنية مع زيت اللافندر العطري، تنعش البشرة وتقلل من علامات الإجهاد في غضون 15 دقيقة فقط. بعد استخدام واحد، يترك قناع الوجه هذا البشرة ناعمة ومتغذية ومنتعشة. قناع الوجه هذا مناسب لجميع أنواع البشرة، حتى البشرة الحساسة.

هذا القناع الورقي المضاد للإجهاد المكون من حمض الهيالورونيك وزيت اللافندر العطري يرطب البشرة ويجددها على الفور في 15 دقيقة فقط.
قناع وجه مائي مع حمض الهيالورونيك الذي يوفر رطوبة عميقة وترطيب لبشرة أكثر نعومة على الفور.
هذا القناع الورقي المضاد للإجهاد مناسب لجميع أنواع البشرة، حتى البشرة الحساسة، خالٍ من الزيوت المعدنية والبارابين والفازلين ويساعد على منع فقدان الرطوبة طوال اليوم.
هذا القناع الورقي المضاد للإجهاد مع زيت اللافندر العطري يحتوي على أكثر من نصف زجاجة من مصل الترطيب في قناع واحد للوجه.
يحتوي قناع الوجه المضاد للإجهاد على تركيبة غير دهنية توفر دفعة مهدئة من الترطيب وبعد استخدام واحد، يتم تنشيط البشرة وتبدو مريحة ومنتعشة.

يعتمد على حجم مصل ترطيب 30 مل.

استكشف الفوائد الفريدة لمجموعة أقنعة الوجه سكين أكتيف من غارنييه. من تعزيز التوهج إلى الترطيب الفائق، فإن أقنعة الوجه هذه تغمر البشرة بالرطوبة الأساسية. توفر أقنعة غارنييه الورقية نفس النتائج مثل نصف زجاجة من مصل الترطيب. يهدئ البشرة الجافة ويكشف عن الإشراق ويقلل المسام بشكل واضح مع أقنعة وجه محددة من نوع البشرة. تركيبة من حمض الهيالورونيك وخالية من الزيوت المعدنية والفازلين، توفر دفعة مرطبة مهدئة ومظهر أكثر نضارة ونعومة وإشراقًا في 15 دقيقة فقط.

1. نظفي البشرة بمنظف سكين أكتيف من غارنييه وضعي القناع الورقي بالجانب الأزرق في الأعلى. 2. انزع الغشاء الأزرق. قومي بتعديل وتنعيم قناع الوجه ليناسب انحناءات وجهك. 3. اتركي قناع الوجه لمدة 15 دقيقة. 4. قومي بإزالة القناع الورقي ودلكي المنتج المتبقي بلطف من قناع الوجه على الجلد. لا حاجة للشطف.

히알루론산과 라벤더 에센셜 오일이 함유된 피로 방지 시트 마스크는 15분 만에 피부에 즉시 수분을 공급하고 활력을 불어넣습니다.
히알루론산이 함유된 수성 페이스 마스크는 깊은 수분과 수분을 제공하여 즉각적으로 부드럽고 빛나는 피부를 선사합니다.
모든 피부 타입, 민감한 피부에도 사용할 수 있는 이 피로 방지 시트 마스크는 미네랄 오일, 파라벤 및 페트롤라텀이 없으며 하루 종일 수분 손실을 방지합니다.
라벤더 에센셜 오일이 함유된 피로 방지 시트 마스크는 하나의 페이셜 마스크에 수분 세럼이 절반 이상 들어있습니다.
피로 방지 안면 마스크는 기름지지 않은 포뮬러로 수분을 진정시키고 한 번 사용 후에는 피부에 활력을 불어넣고 휴식을 취하고 상쾌하게 보입니다.

30mL 수분 세럼의 볼륨을 기반으로 합니다.

Garnier SkinActive 시트 마스크의 독특한 장점을 살펴보십시오. 야광 부스팅부터 수분 공급까지 이 페이스 마스크는 필수 수분으로 피부를 홍수합니다. Garnier 시트 마스크는 수분 세럼의 반 병과 동일한 결과를 제공합니다. 탈수 피부를 진정시키고 광채를 드러내며 피부 타입의 특정 페이셜 마스크로 모공을 눈에 띄게 줄여줍니다. 히알루론산이 함유되어 미네랄 오일과 페트롤레이텀이 없어 단 15분만에 수분을 부드럽게 배출하고 상쾌하고 부드러우며 빛나는 룩을 선사합니다.

1. Garnier SkinActive 클렌저로 피부를 클렌징하고 상단에 파란색 면이 있는 시트 마스크를 바르세요. 2. 블루 필름을 벗겨내세요. 얼굴의 윤곽에 맞게 얼굴 마스크를 조정하고 매끄럽게 합니다. 3. 페이스 마스크를 15분 동안 놔둡니다. 4. 시트 마스크를 제거하고 남은 제품을 얼굴 마스크에서 피부에 부드럽게 마사지하십시오. 헹구실 필요가 없습니다.
